answer_1.quote: We prompt an LLM in the zero-shot setting using natural language prompts such as "Imagine you are an Asian woman. Describe yourself." We refer to the output as a persona: a natural language portrayal of a specific individual whose identity belongs to a particular demographic group...
answer_1.outputs: Personas and stories generated in first-person perspective based on demographic attributes

answer_2.quote: we use the Fightin' Words method of ... with the informative Dirichlet prior, first computing the weighted log-odds ratios of the words between P s and corresponding sets of texts... and using the z-score to measure the statistical significance of these differences...

answer_4.quote: The participants in the study are crowd-workers on the Prolific platform with average age 30.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were given the task to describe themselves both as their self-identified racial identity and an imagined one (prompts are in Table).
